newsitem.title: CHINA: China insurer pays $3.6 mln to fire-hit factory.
newsitem.headline: China insurer pays $3.6 mln to fire-hit factory.

text.p: The property arm of the People's Insurance Company of China (PICC) has made a 30 million yuan ($3.6 million) initial payment to a Beijing chemical plant badly damaged by fire last month, the Financial News said on Thursday.

PICC Property, one of the state-run insurance company's three main subsidiaries, had sent a working group to the Dongfang Chemical Factory in suburban Beijing to investigate the losses caused by the fire on June 27, the newspaper said.
The investigation was continuing, it said but gave no further details.
An official at the plant said on Tuesday it had resumed production in some sections after output was stopped by the explosion and fire, which killed three people and injured 64.
